name: Solid Stone Company Limited
about: Solid Stone Company Limited engages in the natural stone, building materials, and allied building business activities in India, the United States, the Middle East, and the United Kingdom. It offers natural stone products, including slate stone, quartzite, limestone, and sandstone; Indian and exotic marbles; granites; semi-precious stones; and stone, metal, and mix mosaics, including stainless still, brass, and copper. The company also provides various finishes; vessel, Balinese stone paintings, and traventine and Turkish whitewash basin articles; and stone care products, including sealers and color enhancers. In addition, it operates retail outlets. The company was formerly known as Solid Granites Ltd. Solid Stone Company Limited was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
